description:
Returns the handshake and contract of one MCP endpoint: initialize (protocol, server, capabilities, latency), what a plain GET returns, and tools/list rendered to a canonical snapshot with a stable hash, its context footprint in bytes and approximate tokens (total, per tool, top-3 share), an annotation audit (destructiveHint present, absent or true), naming pattern, and which tools carry examples. Keep the answer: attest_drift compares it to a later one. It makes three requests to the server named and takes as long as they take, so call it on a line: a call cut for time returns nothing.
$0.000001 per millisecond on a line.
Paid, on a line. With no wallet code, ZEAM :: Pass buys the time and opens the line for you, with a pass (https://mcp.zeamprism.com/pass) or your own wallet: https://mcp.zeamprism.com/how-to-pay
Example: {"url":"https://mcp.zeamprism.com/mcp"}

line.description: Optional. A line credential, for a client that cannot send the x-line header or _meta["zeam-pass/line"]: the call runs on that line's time.

url.description: string — the MCP endpoint, absolute http(s) URL, e.g. https://host/mcp. Private and internal names and addresses are refused.

name: attest_contract

anyOf.description: hash, tool names, footprint (bytes, approx tokens, per tool, top-3 share), annotations, naming, examples, snapshot

every request made, in the order sent: method, url, request headers of note, status, ms; a request that drew no answer has status 0 and its error, a redirect followed is listed in redirects, and a request still unanswered when a report was cut has unanswered: true
what a plain browser GET of the endpoint returns: redirect | event-stream | html | method-not-allowed | ...
initialize: status, content type, protocol version, server name/version, capabilities, instructions bytes, ms, session id present

title: Read the handshake and tool contract
